name: Park Hyatt Shanghai
insider_take: Soaring above the iconic Lujiazui skyline, Park Hyatt Shanghai redefines luxury at altitude — this is Shanghai at its most dramatic and refined.
whats_special: Occupying floors 79–93 of the Shanghai World Financial Center — once the world's tallest building — Park Hyatt Shanghai delivers breathtaking panoramic views of the Huangpu River and Pudong district. Guests sleep, dine, and swim in the clouds, with an indoor pool on the 85th floor that feels utterly surreal. The hotel's design elegantly blends contemporary Chinese artistry with understated Park Hyatt sophistication, making every corner a visual statement. As a Hyatt Privé property, WhataHotel! guests enjoy exclusive added-value benefits like complimentary breakfast, room upgrades, and early check-in/late checkout when available.
pro_tip: Book a room on a higher floor facing west for staggering sunset views over the Pudong skyline — watching the city light up at dusk from floor 90+ is an experience that simply cannot be replicated anywhere else in Shanghai.
dont_miss: Reserve a table at 100 Century Avenue , the hotel's celebrated sky-high restaurant on the 91st floor, for an unforgettable dining experience above the clouds. Also, take a stroll across the Lujiazui pedestrian bridge to the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower, or hop the ferry across the Huangpu River to explore the historic Bund — Old Shanghai's grand colonial waterfront — just minutes away.
pros: Spectacular skyline views from upper floors of Shanghai World Financial Center
Ultra-luxurious accommodations with contemporary design and premium amenities
Prime location in Lujiazui financial district with easy access to attractions
Exceptional dining options including renowned restaurants and bars
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Modern skyscraper setting may lack traditional Shanghai charm
